records.part: ATEC Water Filtration System (eight 36-inch diameter vessels and associated components) for manganese removal
records.reason: ATEC Water Systems, LLC, is the sole manufacturer and exclusive provider of this proprietary filtration system. No other vendor offers a comparable product with the same design specifications and performance characteristics.

records.part: Main operating valve on each filter tank (automatic multi-port diaphragm type)
records.reason: Main operating valves shall be Bermad IR-4x4-350-P. Substitutions will not be allowed.

records.part: Factory-mounted and wired cycle controller for automatic backwash control
records.reason: The controller to be used is an Alex-Tronic F-12, or similar, which requires a 120 VAC connection which provides a local panel indication of backwash status and alarm.

records.part: Manganese dioxide filter media (pyrolusite) for iron and manganese adsorption filtration
records.reason: Alternative media will not be accepted unless the equipment supplier demonstrates with a __-day pilot test that the media will meet the treatment requirements.

records.part: Design services for the Well 345-1 Treatment System (engineering for bidding, construction, and startup phases)
records.reason: To continue engineering support during the bidding phase, construction, and commissioning of the Well 345-1 Treatment System, DPU is also requesting approval for a Second Amendment to the existing Consultant Services Agreement
